text:
• Store picks now rank every card by what it earns at that store, so a store bonus no longer hides a better card
• Cards a store won't take (Costco is Visa only in the US, Mastercard only in Canada; Loblaws banners skip Amex) are shown last and never picked
• Coffee shops now earn your cards' dining rate
• Amex Cobalt now earns 5x on groceries, with its monthly cap
